newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait bans concerts which violate Islamic law.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait bans concerts which violate Islamic law.

text.p: Kuwait has issued an order banning concerts which break Islamic Sharia law and the country's traditions, the official gazette said on Monday.
The holding of concerts in public places "which violate Sharia rulings and the country's traditions cannot be held or issued licences," said the order by the information ministry.
The order did not spell out what would be considered a violation of Sharia.
But official sources said the move was not a blanket ban and that licences would be issued for events that conform with specific guidelines to guarantee respect for Sharia and common decency.
"If you have a woman dancing on a table (at a concert), that is obviously against our traditions," one said.
Some Islamist MPs had earlier this year pushed in parliament for a law to ban concerts and fashion shows but failed to secure the required majority.
They are opposed to women singing to an audience that includes men and vice-versa as well as women dressing attractively around men who are not close relatives.
